an5.216:1.3: bahuno janassa appiyo hoti amanāpo, luddo ca hoti, vippaṭisārī ca, sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an5.216:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā akkhantiyā.
an5.216:2.3: bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, aluddo ca hoti, avippaṭisārī ca, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.216:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā khantiyāti.
